name: Novotel Danang Premier Han River
short_description: A 328-room riverside tower on the West Bank of the Han River, with a 29th-floor Premier Lounge and balcony views of the Dragon Bridge and city skyline.
ai_summary: Novotel Danang Premier Han River sits on Bach Dang Street in downtown Da Nang, on the West Bank of the Han River, combining 328 rooms and suites with 90 serviced apartments ranging from studios to three-bedroom units. The 29th-floor Premier Lounge offers panoramic views of the river and Danang Beach alongside complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea, and pre-dinner cocktails, while four dining venues, a rooftop pool, and a steam room round out the amenities. Guests consistently praise the spotless rooms, river and city views, and central location within reach of Bana Hills and Marble Mountain.

faqs.question: Does Novotel Danang Premier Han River have river views?
faqs.answer: Yes -- most rooms have balconies facing the Han River, the Dragon Bridge, or the city skyline, and the 29th-floor Premier Lounge offers a further panoramic view over the river and Danang Beach.

faqs.question: Is Novotel Danang Premier Han River centrally located?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's on Bach Dang Street in downtown Da Nang, on the Han River's West Bank, within reach of the airport, Bana Hills, and Marble Mountain.
